locale.nativeLine: - Write item labels in clear English.
locale.otherLine: - Write item labels in language locale '{locale}'.

distractorTiers.standard: a mix of unrelated and same-category decoys
distractorTiers.challenging: include some 'qualitative' decoys that are variants of a target item (e.g. target 'whole milk' -> decoy 'skim milk')

itemRules.themed: Every item fits the theme — everyday, list-style items a person might pack or buy. Generic names only. NO brand names. Wholesome, neutral.
itemRules.grocery: Every item is a common, generic grocery item. NO brand names. Wholesome, neutral.
